300:t_2:131.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So the wind is blowing in our favor.」

300:t_2:132.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Good... We'll leave $$ＥＸ－１０$$ as soon as we're ready.」

300:t_2:134.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Speaking of getting ready, don't forget this.」

300:t_2:136.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「We had it repaired. That mask gave us hope that we could resist.」

300:t_2:137.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「That's right. You're selling yourself as the masked man. Showing your face ruins the bluff.」

300:t_2:139.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Everyone, prepare to leave. We now begin our fight anew.」

300:t_2:141.en:
$$カレン$$
「Thank you, $$キデーラ$$ and $$ポタリア$$. We will see each other again.」

300:t_2:142.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「$$カレン$$... When you see $$エスター$$, tell her...」

300:t_2:143.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「I'm still fighting my own battle.」

300:t_2:144.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah... I'll be sure to tell her.」

300:t_2:145.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「You're about to leave. This is no time for tears.」

300:t_2:146.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「You're ruining your 'Red Devil' reputation, $$カレン$$.」

300:t_2:150.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Well... I doubt I need to worry about you, but don't go dying.」

300:t_2:155.en:
$$キリコ$$
(...Even now, after losing $$フィアナ$$, being separated from my friends, wounded and pursued by enemies, I hadn't lost my will to fight...)

300:t_2:156.en:
$$キリコ$$
(The heat and humidity of $$クメン$$, where I'd once fought alongside my friends and reunited with $$フィアナ$$, had given me something...)

300:t_2:157.en:
$$キリコ$$
(I don't know where I'm headed, or where the world is headed...)

300:t_2:158.en:
$$キリコ$$
(But the fighting continues... With that feeling, I begin walking again...)

301:t_000:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm so glad... You were unconscious for so long...」

301:t_000:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I checked $$ジェニオン$$'s data. This seems to be an isolated island in the Pacific.」

301:t_000:7.en:
$n
「The Pacific... Then that $$時空震動$$ sent us here...」

301:t_001:0.en:
$n
「...It won't start... Is it a mechanical problem...?」

301:t_001:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Even if $$ジェニオン$$ could move, where would we go?」

301:t_001:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone in $c is gone... Do we have anywhere to go...?」

306:t_000:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Our rendezvous point with Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$ is just beyond this jungle.」

306:t_000:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Still, $$シャッコ$$... I never thought you'd be in $$クメン$$, too.」

306:t_000:2.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ invited me, but $$ポタリア$$ had asked me to come here, too.」

306:t_000:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「But are you sure it's all right for you to come with us?」

306:t_000:4.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$ポタリア$$ sent me off. He said I was a member of $c, too.」

306:t_000:5.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Besides... there was something that concerned me personally.」

306:t_000:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(That's what I'd expect of a native of $$クエント$$, whose people expelled the $$異能者#plural$$. Has he sensed the aura enveloping the world...?)

306:t_000:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「There's a $$マーティアル$$ temple here, too...」

306:t_001:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「I heard $$マーティアル$$'s authority collapsed after the raid on the holy land of $$アレギウム$$, but it seems they still have some power.」

306:t_001:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They apparently call that incident the 《$$赫い霍乱$$》 of $$アレギウム$$.」

306:t_001:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That felt great. Those bastards doing whatever they wanted in God's name became clowns in one fell swoop.」

306:t_001:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Oh, sorry, $$キリコ$$. I got carried away.」

306:t_001:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't worry about it. It's in the past now.」

306:t_001:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$キリコ$$ lost $$フィアナ$$ in that battle...)

306:t_001:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「Still, this is a bold plan, going right under $$マーティアル$$'s nose.」

306:t_001:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Won't they... try to get revenge on us?」

306:t_001:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If they do, we'll fight them off.」

306:t_001:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「Did we come here just to fight!?」

306:t_001:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There's no need to worry. We have $$キリコ$$, the central figure in $$アレギウム$$'s $$赫い霍乱$$.」

306:t_001:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see. They know all too well how terrifying he is, so they wouldn't dare attack carelessly.」

306:t_001:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And if $$サイデリアル$$ comes, they'll intervene in the battle. That will give us an opening, too.」

306:t_001:16.en:
$$スザク$$
「With our forces so depleted, we have to use other organizations' movements to our advantage.」

306:t_001:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But... Flying KMFs are fine, but $$ロジャー$$ and us AS pilots can't get to $$メリダ島$$ like this.」

306:t_001:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「We couldn't possibly ask $$ポタリア$$ and the others to arrange a transport plane for us...」

306:t_001:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「We'll just have to work that out as we go. First, let's get out of the jungle.」

306:t_001:20.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...It seems it won't be that easy, though.」

306:t_002:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Those are black $$アクシオ$$s and ATs with scissors!」

306:t_002:2.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I've found you...! I've found you, $c!」

306:t_002:5.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Seriously...? $$カン・ユー$$'s hunch was right.」

306:t_002:6.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Ah... For the sake of my pride, that wasn't a pun, okay?」

306:t_002:7.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Hmph... Even that walking jinx is useful sometimes.」

306:t_002:8.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Contact $$アマルガム$$'s main force. Tell them we've found the targets.」

306:t_002:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$カン・ユー$$! You're still working for $$アマルガム$$!?」
